arguments.cover_letter:
You need a storefront with cart and checkout for your education business, and the projects below are the closest matches from my portfolio.

On Donation platform for an education client I used Next.js, Stripe, Tailwind CSS and processed 14,000 donations with zero payment disputes.

On Subscription billing dashboard for a SaaS client I used Next.js, Stripe, TypeScript and recovered 9% of failed payments automatically.

On Marketplace storefront rebuild for an e-commerce client I used Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript and improved Lighthouse performance from 54 to 96.

I have also worked with MongoDB, React on other client projects.

I can start this week. Would a 20 minute call suit you to confirm scope and milestones?
screening_answers: The closest match is Donation platform, where I processed 14,000 donations with zero payment disputes.
